items.description: A sharp-smelling restorative from the museum first-aid cabinet. The label predates the bottle.
Warm filings shed by Bellweather's impossible clockwork. They hold medicinal compounds unusually well.
Black resin gathered beneath unburned roots in the Ashen Age. It becomes warm when mixed with brass.
A field salve that carries steady warmth without flame.
A clear fragment trapped inside a recovered clock shard. Different years move across its surface.
A hand-set lens that reveals the hour beneath an object's remembered surface.
